annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 152/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation setting product requirements for unmanned aircraft systems in the 'open' category (classes C0–C4) and remote identification add-ons, with CE marking and conformity assessment, notified body rules, market surveillance, certification triggers for higher-risk UAS, and obligations on third-country operators.
key_provisions_or_claims: Open-category UAS must meet class C0–C4 technical requirements (mass, speed, height limits, geo-awareness, remote ID, noise limits).
Manufacturers, importers and distributors bear defined obligations including CE marking, EU declaration of conformity and 10-year documentation retention.
Conformity assessment via internal production control, EU-type examination or full quality assurance, with notified bodies.
UAS carrying people or dangerous goods, or large UAS over assemblies of people, require design, production and maintenance certification.
Third-country UAS operators must comply with Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 in European airspace.
